scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two robed adults stand beneath an olive tree, looking into a sunlit limestone quarry. A large hewn block rests before a cut recess in the rock face. Wildflowers grow among the foreground stones, with pale hills beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative quarry setting makes the verse's rock-and-pit metaphor visible. The hewn block beside its parent bedrock suggests remembering one's origins; the two anonymous observers suggest attentive seeking. The verse does not describe an actual visit to a quarry, and neither observer represents God or a named ancestor.
